purpose: Prioritized outbound requests required to obtain independent raw data for the IJHE validation objective.
dispatch_prerequisites: Connect an approved Gmail account or provide another authorized institutional mail channel.
Review each draft and confirm the named custodian/recipient before sending.
Keep the frozen acceptance criteria and no-fitting scoring protocol unchanged before any received file is opened.
selection_rule: Prioritize independent station-to-vehicle or real-station logger candidates that can close the full-loop gate; incident/release candidates are auxiliary safety/LLM evidence and do not replace physics validation.

required_for_full_loop: independent provenance and immutable file digest
written reuse terms permitting derived results in an open repository and journal
preferred: storage-bank, compressor, precooler and dispenser state
alarm, abort, maintenance and calibration flags
freeze_protocol: quarantine received files before reading outcomes
record source URL, access date, licence and SHA-256
freeze eligible cases, split, implementation commit and error screens
run once without case-specific fitting or time warping
retain every eligible failure and publish the claim boundary

queue.minimum_acceptance: At least eight eligible fills with common time base and vehicle/receptacle pressure plus mass flow or transferred mass.
queue.rights: De-identification and written reuse permission required; public report alone is context only.
queue.next_action: Project owner reviews and sends the draft to CARB data custodian.

queue.candidate_type: real liquid-hydrogen station operational logger archive
queue.reported_scope: 16 hours at one-second resolution; 35 MPa dispensers, 70 MPa dispenser, 90 MPa compressor, high-pressure storage and liquid-hydrogen pump/tank
queue.minimum_acceptance: Receive the six operational files, verify a common time base and pressure/mass channels, then freeze untouched station events before scoring.
queue.rights: The record reports complete sharing, but written permission for derived metrics, open-repository deposition and IJHE publication must be confirmed; raw download currently requires a data application.
queue.next_action: Submit the NBSDC/Tongji data application; quarantine, hash and rights-check any received files before opening numerical outcomes.

queue.minimum_acceptance: A de-identified holdout with common time base, tank capacity, initial conditions and protocol metadata.
queue.rights: NREL/NFCTEC release terms and permission for derived metrics must be documented.
queue.next_action: Project owner contacts the published technical-validation custodian.

queue.candidate_type: independent real HRFF cascade and directly-pressurized experiments
queue.minimum_acceptance: Raw synchronized traces for at least one cascade and one directly-pressurized run with run identifiers, initial conditions, capacity, protocol metadata and untouched holdout eligibility.
queue.rights: Cal State LA/author custodian must grant written permission for derived metrics, open-repository deposition and journal publication.
queue.next_action: Project owner reviews research/CALSTATE_CASCADE_EXPERIMENT_DATA_REQUEST_DRAFT.md, then contacts the HRFF custodian if authorised.

queue.candidate_type: real ZBT multi-bank HRS sampling and dispenser logger archive
queue.minimum_acceptance: A de-identified synchronized export with at least eight eligible events or a justified smaller protocol-defined subset, plus channel definitions, calibration data and immutable provenance.
queue.rights: Authors or ZBT custodian must confirm written permission for derived metrics, open repository deposition and journal publication; the article states raw data are available on request.
queue.next_action: Project owner reviews research/ZBT_HRS_DATA_REQUEST_DRAFT.md and contacts the corresponding author through an approved institutional channel.

queue.minimum_acceptance: De-identified machine-readable synchronized logger files for complete fills with tank capacity, initial conditions, protocol metadata and at least one independent pressure/temperature/flow boundary.
queue.rights: PRHYDE/ZBT data custodian must confirm research reuse, derived-publication and repository-deposit terms.
queue.next_action: Send the prepared request to the PRHYDE/ZBT test-field data custodian identified from the D6.7 report.
